$comment: Exact provider CLI versions production may execute, and the exact artifact that carries them. Updating any of this is a reviewed dependency change, never an ambient `latest`: edit the versions, run the build-agent-toolchain workflow, and record the digest it reports back here. The build installs from deploy/agent-toolchain/package-lock.json with --ignore-scripts, so no package lifecycle script runs in CI or in production; the native binaries each package ships are what production executes, with no Node runtime.
